name: Stackless Traversal
definition: An algorithm for traversing a hierarchical volume structure (N3-tree) that avoids using a stack data structure by recalculating DDA parameters at each descent and ascent in the tree.
summary: Stackless Traversal is a hierarchical volume rendering method that traverses N3-trees without a stack by recalculating DDA parameters and using parent pointers, optimizing GPU register pressure and branch divergence.
